interpretation.initial_u: c_puct * network prior, with root Q=0 and sqrt(max(1,N))=1 before the first simulation.
interpretation.final_u: PUCT exploration term after the requested simulations.
interpretation.q: Root edge mean value from the perspective of the root player.
interpretation.final_puct_score: Final root Q + U. This is a post-search snapshot, not a historical trace of every selection decision.
interpretation.uniform_legal_action_prior: 1 / number of legal root actions; useful as a branching-factor reference, not a policy target.
